name: Summer Bolete
description:
The **Summer Bolete** (*Boletus reticulatus*) is an early-fruiting relative of the porcini, often appearing from late spring through summer. It has a pale to brown cap with a characteristic network pattern and a similar pore layer and stout stem.

It associates with broadleaf trees, especially oak and beech, and is a choice edible with a nutty flavour similar to the classic porcini.
